observations: Torah LM2:69 contains only one coherent thematic cluster: the principle of נשאת ונושאת (carried-and-carries), which ברכה embodies. All concepts in the Torah — ברכה, נשאת ונושאת, the Merkavah, the Ark, כי רוח החיה באופנים, and the drink-carrier — are expressions of this single principle. There is no second independent domain. The Torah does not develop a good/evil polarity — it has no evil counterpart package. The brief parenthetical at the end (שברים, cooling, heating) is left entirely unexplained by the Rebbe himself ('לא בֵּאֵר הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה כְּלָל') and therefore yields no structured bechina relationships that could form a new package. The dataset coverage (1 edge, 2 nodes) is sparse relative to the source text's conceptual richness, but the gap is one of missing nodes within the existing package, not evidence of an independent new thematic domain.
